```
['add all DensePose configuration options including head, HRNet, bootstrap, dataset category, and evaluation settings to a Detectron2 CfgNode', 'add DensePose head configuration options for ROI-based dense pose estimation including predictor, loss, and decoder settings', 'add Continuous Surface Embeddings configuration options for embedding size, loss weights, and cycle consistency loss parameters', 'add HRNet backbone configuration options including stage modules, branches, channels, and HRFPN output channels', 'load and convert bootstrap dataset entries from dicts into CfgNode format that comply with the bootstrap specification']
```
